plugin.name: updater
plugin.author: distantorigin
plugin.description:
Update Plugin - Control the Miriani-Next updater binary
Commands: update switch - Opens the channel switcher interactively update switch <dev|stable> - Switches to specified channel non-interactively update check - Checks for updates without installing update version - Shows the updater version update install - Downloads and installs the updater if not present update help - Shows this help update - With no arguments, checks for and performs an update with restart confirmation if needed update quietly - Checks for and applies an update silently, with no prompts or focus stealing (used by automatic updates) update quietly auto - Silent update; if a restart is required, restart the client automatically update quietly notify - Silent update; if a restart is required, notify you to restart when you return update reset - Deletes the local manifest and runs an update to rebuild it (may cause files to be reindexed or redownloaded)

muclient.script:
execute = require("execute") async = require("async")
function OnPluginInstall() AcceleratorTo("ctrl+u", "update_run()", sendto.script) if not check_updater_exists() then Note("The updater is not installed. Automatically installing...") Execute("update install") end end
function check_updater_exists() local homedir = GetInfo(66) local updater_path = homedir .. "update.exe"
local file = io.open(updater_path, "r") if file then file:close() return true end return false end
function is_valid_pe(path) local file = io.open(path, "rb") if not file then return false end
local signature = file:read(2) if signature ~= "MZ" then file:close() return false end
file:seek("set", 60) local offset_bytes = file:read(4) if not offset_bytes or #offset_bytes ~= 4 then file:close() return false end
local b1, b2, b3, b4 = string.byte(offset_bytes, 1, 4) local pe_offset = b1 + b2 * 256 + b3 * 65536 + b4 * 16777216 file:seek("set", pe_offset) local pe_signature = file:read(4) file:close() return pe_signature == "PE\0\0" end
function download_updater(callback) local homedir = GetInfo(66) local download_url = "https://github.com/distantorigin/next-launcher/releases/latest/download/miriani.exe" local updater_path = homedir .. "update.exe" local staged_path = updater_path .. ".download" local backup_path = updater_path .. ".backup"
Note("Downloading updater...") os.remove(staged_path)
-- Use curl to download (handles SNI, redirects, everything properly -- sigh). Windows 10 1803 required. local cmd = 'curl --fail --show-error --location --max-time 120 -o "' .. staged_path .. '" "' .. download_url .. '"'
execute.doAsyncExecute(cmd, function(success, output, exit_code, err) if success and exit_code == 0 then if not is_valid_pe(staged_path) then os.remove(staged_path) Note("Error: Downloaded updater is not a valid PE executable") if callback then callback(false) end return end
local existing = io.open(updater_path, "rb") local has_existing_updater = existing ~= nil if existing then existing:close() end
local old_backup = io.open(backup_path, "rb") if old_backup then old_backup:close() local removed, remove_err = os.remove(backup_path) if not removed then os.remove(staged_path) Note("Error: Could not remove stale updater backup: " .. tostring(remove_err)) if callback then callback(false) end return end end
if has_existing_updater then local backed_up, backup_err = os.rename(updater_path, backup_path) if not backed_up then os.remove(staged_path) Note("Error: Could not back up existing update.exe: " .. tostring(backup_err)) if callback then callback(false) end return end end
local replaced, replace_err = os.rename(staged_path, updater_path) if not replaced then os.remove(staged_path) Note("Error: Could not replace update.exe: " .. tostring(replace_err)) if has_existing_updater then local restored, restore_err = os.rename(backup_path, updater_path) if not restored then Note("Error: Could not restore previous update.exe: " .. tostring(restore_err)) end end if callback then callback(false) end return end
if has_existing_updater then local removed, remove_err = os.remove(backup_path) if not removed then Note("Warning: Could not remove updater backup: " .. tostring(remove_err)) end end
local file = io.open(updater_path, "rb") local size = file and file:seek("end") or 0 if file then file:close() end Note("Successfully downloaded update.exe (" .. size .. " bytes) to " .. homedir) if callback then callback(true) end return end
os.remove(staged_path) Note("Error: Failed to download update.exe (curl exit code: " .. tostring(exit_code) .. ")") if output and #output > 0 then for _, line in ipairs(output) do Note(" " .. line) end end if callback then callback(false) end end, { hide_window = true, working_dir = homedir, timeout = 120 }) end
function get_current_channel() local homedir = GetInfo(66) local channel_file = homedir .. ".update-channel"
local file = io.open(channel_file, "r") if not file then return "stable" end
local channel = file:read("*all") file:close()
channel = channel:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") return channel or "stable" end
function parse_check_output(output_lines) local info = { update_available = false, restart_required = false, version = nil, channel = nil, changes = 0 }
for _, line in ipairs(output_lines) do if line:match("Update available: Yes") then info.update_available = true elseif line:match("Restart required: Yes") then info.restart_required = true elseif line:match("Version: (.+)") then info.version = line:match("Version: (.+)") elseif line:match("Channel: (.+)") then info.channel = line:match("Channel: (.+)") elseif line:match("Changes: (%d+)") then info.changes = tonumber(line:match("Changes: (%d+)")) end end
return info end
function run_updater_hidden(args, callback) if not check_updater_exists() then Note("Error: update.exe not found. Please run 'update install' to download it.") if callback then callback(false, {}, -1) end return end
local homedir = GetInfo(66) local updater = homedir .. "update.exe" local cmd = '"' .. updater .. '" ' .. args .. " -non-interactive"
execute.doAsyncExecute(cmd, function(success, output, exit_code, err) if success then if callback then callback(success, output, exit_code) end else if err and err:match("error 740") then Note("Error: Windows requires administrator privileges to run the updater.") Note("To fix this permanently:") Note(" 1. Right-click MUSHclient.exe and select 'Properties'") Note(" 2. Go to the 'Compatibility' tab") Note(" 3. Check 'Run this program as an administrator'") Note(" 4. Click OK and restart MUSHclient") -- Don't call callback - we've already shown the user what to do return else Note("Updater error: " .. (err or "Unknown error")) if callback then callback(false, {}, exit_code or -1) end end end end, { hide_window = true, working_dir = homedir, timeout = 60 }) end
function run_updater_visible(args) if not check_updater_exists() then Note("Error: update.exe not found. Please run 'update install' to download it.") return end
local homedir = GetInfo(66) local updater = homedir .. "update.exe"
-- Prefer explicit path; homedir can contain spaces utils.shellexecute('"' .. updater .. '"', args, homedir, "open", 1) end
function update_dispatcher(name, line, wildcards)
local args = wildcards[1]
if args then args = args:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
-- Parse the command if not args or args == "" or args:match("^quietly") then -- No arguments or ran with quietly--run update. -- Callers may append a restart action ("quietly auto" / "quietly notify") -- to control how a restart-required update is handled while unattended. local quiet = args ~= nil and args:match("^quietly") ~= nil local restart_action = args and args:match("^quietly%s+(%S+)") or nil update_run(quiet, restart_action) else -- Split args into command and parameters local cmd, params = args:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$")
if cmd == "install" then if check_updater_exists() then Note("update.exe already exists. No need to download. If you wish to force the updater to reinstall itself, use 'update reinstall'.") else download_updater(function(success) if success then Note("Installation complete. Running update check and generating manifest...") run_updater_visible("-generate-manifest") DoAfterSpecial(5, "update_run(0)", sendto.script) else Note("Installation failed.") end end) end
elseif cmd == "reinstall" then download_updater(function(success) if success then Note("Reinstallation complete. Running update check...") update_run(0) else Note("Reinstallation failed.") end end)
elseif cmd == "switch" then if params == "" then -- Interactive switch run_updater_visible("switch") elseif params == "dev" or params == "stable" then -- Switch to specific channel run_updater_hidden("switch " .. params, function(success, output, exit_code) if success and #output > 0 then for _, line in ipairs(output) do Note(line) end else Note("Error: Failed to switch channel") end end) else Note("Invalid channel. Use 'dev' or 'stable'.") end
elseif cmd == "check" then run_updater_hidden("check", function(success, output, exit_code) if success and #output > 0 then for _, line in ipairs(output) do Note(line) end else Note("Error: Failed to check for updates") end end)
elseif cmd == "version" or cmd == "-v" then run_updater_hidden("-version", function(success, output, exit_code) if success and #output > 0 then for _, line in ipairs(output) do Note(line) end else Note("Error: Failed to get updater version") end end)
elseif cmd == "reset" then local message = "This will delete the local manifest and re-run the update process to rebuild it.\n\n" .. "Depending on the state of your install, this may cause files to be reindexed or redownloaded.\n\n" .. "Continue?" local response = utils.msgbox(message, "Reset Manifest", "yesno", "?", 2) if response == "yes" then local homedir = GetInfo(66) local manifest_path = homedir .. ".manifest" local ok, err = os.remove(manifest_path) if not ok then -- Missing file is fine -- the goal is that it isn't there afterwards. local check = io.open(manifest_path, "r") if check then check:close() Note("Error: Failed to delete .manifest: " .. (err or "unknown error")) return end end Note("Manifest deleted. Running update to rebuild...") update_run() else Note("Reset cancelled.") end
elseif cmd == "help" or cmd == "-h" or cmd == "--help" then Note(GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 3))
else Note("Invalid command. Type 'update help' for usage.") end end end
-- Client-side connect-time update check. Runs the hidden check and broadcasts -- the result so the soundpack can play a sound, notify, and (if configured) -- fire "update quietly" -- without waiting on the OOB "outdated" tag. -- msg 555 payload: "yes:<version>" if an update is available, "no" otherwise. function check_updates_and_broadcast() run_updater_hidden("check", function(success, output, exit_code) if not success or not output or #output == 0 then BroadcastPlugin(555, "no") return end
local info = parse_check_output(output) if info.update_available then BroadcastPlugin(555, "yes:" .. (info.version or "")) else BroadcastPlugin(555, "no") end end) end
-- Writes a marker file so the soundpack can tell the player, on their return, -- that a silently-installed update still needs a client restart to finish. function write_restart_pending(version) local homedir = GetInfo(66) local file = io.open(homedir .. ".update-restart-pending", "w") if file then file:write(version or "") file:close() end end
-- Main update function (with restart check) function update_run(quiet, restart_action) restart_action = restart_action or "notify" if not quiet then Note("Checking for updates...") -- Clear any stale quiet marker so a manual update isn't mistaken for silent. os.remove(GetInfo(66) .. ".update-quiet") end
-- First, check if updates are available (hidden, no console flash!) run_updater_hidden("check", function(success, output, exit_code) if not success or not output or #output == 0 then Note("Error: Failed to check for updates") return end
local info = parse_check_output(output)
if not info.update_available then if not quiet then BroadcastPlugin(999, "") Note("Already up to date!") end return end
BroadcastPlugin(888, info.version)
Note("Updating to version "..info.version)
-- Get the current channel local channel = get_current_channel()
local response if not quiet then -- Build the message local message = "A new update is available on the " .. channel .. " channel! Would you like to install it now?"
if info.restart_required then message = message .. "\n\nNote: This update requires MUSHclient to be restarted." end
-- Build the title local title = "Update Available" if info.version then title = "Update to Version " .. info.version end
-- Ask user for confirmation response = utils.msgbox(message, title, "yesno", "?", 1) else response = "yes" end
if response == "yes" then if quiet then -- Marker so post-update handlers know this run was silent and can -- suppress noisy UI (e.g. the changelog popup). local marker = GetInfo(66) .. ".update-quiet" local mf = io.open(marker, "w") if mf then mf:close() end -- Unattended update: never pop a window that steals focus. if info.restart_required then if restart_action == "auto" then -- Auto-restart: uses the proven detached path. A restart changes -- focus by its nature, so there's nothing to steal from an idle player. run_updater_visible("-allow-restart -non-interactive") else -- Apply silently without restarting, then leave a marker so the -- player is told to restart when they come back to the keyboard. local pending_version = info.version run_updater_hidden("-non-interactive", function(success) if success then write_restart_pending(pending_version) end end) end else -- Routine silent update: install hidden so focus stays put. run_updater_hidden("-non-interactive") end else Note("Starting update...")
-- Run the update if info.restart_required then run_updater_visible("-allow-restart -non-interactive") else run_updater_visible("-non-interactive") end end else if not quiet then Note("Update cancelled.") end end end) end
